description: Clone a Consumption Logic App workflow to a Standard Logic App. IMPORTANT: Always run validate_clone_workflow first to check for compatibility issues before cloning. This copies the workflow definition from a Consumption Logic App to a new workflow in an existing Standard Logic App. The target Standard Logic App must already exist and the target workflow name must not already exist. Connections will need to be reconfigured after cloning.

resourceGroupName.description: Source Consumption Logic App resource group name

subscriptionId.description: Source Consumption Logic App subscription ID

targetLogicAppName.description: Target Standard Logic App name (must already exist)

targetResourceGroupName.description: Target Standard Logic App resource group name

targetSubscriptionId.description: Target Standard Logic App subscription ID (defaults to source subscription if not provided)

targetWorkflowName.description: Name for the new workflow in the Standard Logic App

name: clone_workflow
